collection.title: Renault Megane Saloon 2006 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Renault Megane Saloon 2006 to 2009 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
